decisions.statement: A name imported and then exported is judged as a name exported straight from its source.
A new spelling on the way out hides nothing.
A type-only re-export is a re-export.
`export *` is refused whole rather than name by name.
A re-export inside another declaration is refused like a re-export at the top.
A barrel quietly undoes one way into a folder.
An imported value bound to a fresh exported name is a declaration this file made.

definition: the check refusing a file that exports a name it did not declare itself
